# Fly-in Fly-out Contact List Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Build a scrollable contact list where each row flies in/out via piecewise-interpolated opacity, translateY, and scale as it enters and exits the viewport — effect scrubbed continuously to scroll position using IntersectionObserver + rAF.

**Architecture:** Single `index.html`. 15 contact rows generated by JS from a data array (keeps HTML compact). An `IntersectionObserver` (root = the `.stage` scroll container) maintains a `Set` of currently-near-viewport rows. A rAF-throttled scroll handler iterates only that Set and computes `pos = (row.offsetTop - scrollTop) / viewportH`, then maps it through a three-zone piecewise lerp to produce opacity, translateY, and scale. Controls panel has three sliders + effect-mode radios + zone-preview toggle.

**Tech Stack:** Plain HTML5, CSS custom properties, vanilla JS, IntersectionObserver. No libraries, no build step.

Create `animations/01-scroll-based/fly-in-fly-out-contact-list/README.md`:

```markdown
# Fly-in Fly-out Contact List

[Live demo](index.html)

## What it is

Each row in a scrollable contact list animates through three viewport zones:
an entry zone at the bottom (row fades and translates in from below), an
active zone in the middle (row is fully visible and stable), and an exit zone
at the top (row fades and translates out upward). The effect is continuous and
bidirectional — scrubbed to scroll position rather than triggered once. A row
that scrolls back into the active zone after exiting reappears smoothly.

## When to use it

- Contact lists, activity feeds, and inbox views where long lists need
  visual structure as the user scans
- Any vertically scrollable list where spatial cues help orient the user
  within the content
- Messaging app chat lists, notification trays, search results

## How it works

For each row currently near the viewport (tracked by `IntersectionObserver`),
a single `requestAnimationFrame` callback computes:

```js
const pos = (row.offsetTop - stage.scrollTop) / stage.clientHeight;
// pos ≈ 0: row top aligns with viewport top
// pos ≈ 1: row top aligns with viewport bottom
```

Three zones (Z = zone size, default 0.25):

```js
if (pos < Z) {             // exit zone (top)
  const t = pos / Z;       // 0 = fully exited, 1 = entering active
  opacity = lerp(0, 1, t);
  ty      = lerp(-DIST, 0, t);
  scale   = lerp(SCALE_MIN, 1, t);
} else if (pos > 1 - Z) { // entry zone (bottom)
  const t = (1 - pos) / Z; // 0 = fully below, 1 = entering active
  opacity = lerp(0, 1, t);
  ty      = lerp(DIST, 0, t);
  scale   = lerp(SCALE_MIN, 1, t);
} // else: active zone — opacity=1, ty=0, scale=1
```

An `IntersectionObserver` with `rootMargin: '25% 0px'` maintains a Set of
rows currently in or near the viewport. The rAF callback iterates only that
Set — never all 15 rows unconditionally.

## Key parameters

| Parameter | Default | Effect |
|-----------|---------|--------|
| `DIST` | 40px | Translation distance at zone edges |
| `SCALE_MIN` | 0.94 | Scale at zone edges (1 = no shrink) |
| `Z` | 0.25 | Fraction of viewport height for each zone |
| Effect mode | all combined | opacity + translateY + scale together |

## Production notes

- **Continuous vs. one-time reveal.** A common pattern is to trigger a reveal
  animation once per element when it first enters the viewport and never
  reverse it. This demo is bidirectional — scrolling back up restores the
  fly-in state. The distinction matters for context: one-time reveals work
  for reading flows; continuous effects work for navigational lists where
  the user scans up and down repeatedly.
- **Performance pattern.** `IntersectionObserver` filters the work set to
  only rows near the viewport. The rAF callback then applies
  `transform + opacity` — compositor-only properties that never trigger
  layout or paint. Together these keep the per-frame cost proportional to
  the number of visible rows, not the total list length.
- **Real-world examples.** The iOS Contacts app, Telegram's chat list, and
  Notion's sidebar all use variants of this entering/exiting fade-translate.
  The scale component is what makes it feel physical rather than flat.
- **Library equivalents.** GSAP ScrollTrigger with `scrub: true` and a
  timeline per row achieves the same piecewise control. Framer Motion's
  `useScroll` with `useTransform` per item is the React equivalent; it
  handles the `IntersectionObserver` bookkeeping automatically.
- **Accessibility.** The combination of translate + scale is a known
  vestibular trigger. Under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`, disable
  translate and scale entirely; use only a subtle opacity fade
  (0.3 → 1) at the zone edges so the list remains spatially stable.

## See also

- [Cover Card to Fixed Header](../cover-card-to-fixed-header/) — the same
  single-progress piecewise lerp model applied to a morphing header.
- [Parallax Scrolling](../parallax-scrolling/) — scroll-position driving
  layer transforms; the architectural pattern this builds on.
```

  </aside>

</div>

</body>
</html>

## Task 3: Contact Data, IntersectionObserver, and Scroll Animation JS

- [ ] **Step 1: Insert script block**

Find `</body>\n</html>` at end and replace with:

```html
<script>
  const CONTACTS = [
    {i:'SK',n:'Sara Klein',    s:'Design lead · Berlin',  t:'now', b:0,o:true },
    {i:'MR',n:'Marco Rossi',   s:'Engineering · Milan',   t:'2h',  b:3,o:false},
    {i:'YT',n:'Yuki Tanaka',   s:'Product · Tokyo',       t:'1d',  b:0,o:false},
    {i:'AO',n:'Amara Okafor',  s:'Research · Lagos',      t:'now', b:0,o:true },
    {i:'LP',n:'Lena Park',     s:'UX · Seoul',            t:'5m',  b:1,o:true },
    {i:'JB',n:'Jules Bernard', s:'Data · Paris',          t:'3h',  b:0,o:false},
    {i:'RM',n:'Ravi Mehta',    s:'Infra · Mumbai',        t:'2d',  b:0,o:false},
    {i:'CF',n:'Clara Ferreira',s:'Brand · São Paulo',     t:'30m', b:7,o:true },
    {i:'SO',n:"Sam O'Brien",   s:'Mobile · Dublin',       t:'now', b:0,o:true },
    {i:'NW',n:'Nia Williams',  s:'Growth · London',       t:'1h',  b:2,o:false},
    {i:'DK',n:'Dae-Jung Kim',  s:'Security · Busan',      t:'4h',  b:0,o:false},
    {i:'HZ',n:'Hana Zhao',     s:'ML · Shanghai',         t:'now', b:0,o:true },
    {i:'TN',n:'Tariq Nassar',  s:'Strategy · Dubai',      t:'2d',  b:0,o:false},
    {i:'EV',n:'Elena Vasquez', s:'Finance · Mexico City', t:'45m', b:4,o:false},
    {i:'IB',n:'Ivan Brykov',   s:'Platform · Kyiv',       t:'now', b:0,o:true },
  ];
  const COLORS = ['#1a3a5c','#2d1b3d','#1e3a1e','#3d2000','#1a3a3a',
                  '#3a1a1a','#1a2a3d','#2d1a3d','#1e2d1e','#3a2a00'];
  const avatarColor = i => COLORS[(i.charCodeAt(0)+i.charCodeAt(1))%COLORS.length];

  const list = document.getElementById('contact-list');
  const rows = CONTACTS.map(c => {
    const el = document.createElement('div');
    el.className = 'row';
    el.innerHTML =
      `<div class="avatar" style="background:${avatarColor(c.i)}">${c.i}</div>` +
      `<div class="row-info"><div class="row-name">${c.n}</div>` +
      `<div class="row-sub">${c.s}</div></div>` +
      `<div class="row-meta">` +
      (c.b ? `<span class="badge">${c.b}</span>` : `<span class="dot ${c.o?'online':'offline'}"></span>`) +
      `<span class="meta-time">${c.t}</span></div>`;
    list.appendChild(el);
    return el;
  });

  const stage      = document.getElementById('stage');
  const scrollProg = document.getElementById('scroll-prog');
  const visCount   = document.getElementById('visible-count');
  const distSl     = document.getElementById('dist-sl');
  const distVal    = document.getElementById('dist-val');
  const scaleSl    = document.getElementById('scale-sl');
  const scaleVal   = document.getElementById('scale-val');
  const zoneSl     = document.getElementById('zone-sl');
  const zoneVal    = document.getElementById('zone-val');
  const previewTog = document.getElementById('preview-tog');
  const resetBtn   = document.getElementById('reset-btn');
  const zoneOverlay= document.getElementById('zone-overlay');
  const zoneExit   = document.getElementById('zone-exit');
  const zoneEntry  = document.getElementById('zone-entry');
  const motionMQ   = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');

  let DIST = 40, SCALE = 0.94, Z = 0.25, mode = 'all';
  let ticking = false;
  const visible = new Set();

  const io = new IntersectionObserver(entries => {
    entries.forEach(e => e.isIntersecting ? visible.add(e.target) : visible.delete(e.target));
  }, { root: stage, rootMargin: '25% 0px', threshold: 0 });
  rows.forEach(r => io.observe(r));

  function lerp(a, b, t) { return a + (b - a) * t; }
  function clamp(v, lo, hi) { return Math.min(Math.max(v, lo), hi); }

  function applyRow(el) {
    const pos = (el.offsetTop - stage.scrollTop) / stage.clientHeight;
    const reduced = motionMQ.matches;
    let opacity = 1, ty = 0, sc = 1;

    if (pos < Z) {
      const t = clamp(pos / Z, 0, 1);
      opacity = reduced ? lerp(0.3, 1, t) : (mode !== 'translate' ? lerp(0, 1, t) : 1);
      if (!reduced && mode !== 'fade') ty = lerp(-DIST, 0, t);
      if (!reduced && mode === 'all')  sc = lerp(SCALE, 1, t);
    } else if (pos > 1 - Z) {
      const t = clamp((1 - pos) / Z, 0, 1);
      opacity = reduced ? lerp(0.3, 1, t) : (mode !== 'translate' ? lerp(0, 1, t) : 1);
      if (!reduced && mode !== 'fade') ty = lerp(DIST, 0, t);
      if (!reduced && mode === 'all')  sc = lerp(SCALE, 1, t);
    }

    el.style.opacity   = opacity;
    el.style.transform = `translate3d(0,${ty}px,0) scale(${sc})`;
  }

  function updateOverlay() {
    const h = stage.clientHeight, zH = Math.round(h * Z);
    zoneExit.style.height  = zH + 'px';
    zoneEntry.style.height = zH + 'px';
    zoneEntry.style.top    = (h - zH) + 'px';
  }

  function update() {
    const st  = stage.scrollTop;
    const max = stage.scrollHeight - stage.clientHeight;
    scrollProg.textContent = max > 0 ? Math.round(st / max * 100) + '%' : '0%';
    visible.forEach(applyRow);
    visCount.textContent = visible.size;
    ticking = false;
  }

  stage.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
    if (!ticking) { requestAnimationFrame(update); ticking = true; }
  }, { passive: true });

  distSl.addEventListener('input',  () => { DIST  = +distSl.value;        distVal.textContent  = DIST + 'px';   update(); });
  scaleSl.addEventListener('input', () => { SCALE = scaleSl.value / 100;  scaleVal.textContent = SCALE.toFixed(2); update(); });
  zoneSl.addEventListener('input',  () => { Z     = zoneSl.value / 100;   zoneVal.textContent  = zoneSl.value + '%'; updateOverlay(); update(); });
  document.querySelectorAll('input[name="mode"]').forEach(r =>
    r.addEventListener('change', () => { mode = r.value; update(); }));
  previewTog.addEventListener('change', () => zoneOverlay.classList.toggle('visible', previewTog.checked));

  resetBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
    distSl.value  = 40;  DIST  = 40;   distVal.textContent  = '40px';
    scaleSl.value = 94;  SCALE = 0.94; scaleVal.textContent = '0.94';
    zoneSl.value  = 25;  Z     = 0.25; zoneVal.textContent  = '25%';
    document.querySelector('input[value="all"]').checked = true; mode = 'all';
    previewTog.checked = false; zoneOverlay.classList.remove('visible');
    stage.scrollTop = 0; updateOverlay(); update();
  });

  updateOverlay();
  update();
</script>
</body>
</html>
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Verify in browser**

Open the file. Scroll down inside the dark stage.

Expected — visual behavior:
- Rows slide in from the bottom as they enter: fade from invisible + translate up from +40px
- Rows in the center of the viewport: fully visible, no transform
- Rows sliding off the top: fade out + translate up to -40px
- Scrolling back up reverses the effect — rows reappear
- Effect is smooth, not a one-time trigger

Expected — controls:

### Type consistency

- `DIST` — `Number`, set from `+distSl.value`; used in `lerp(-DIST, 0, t)` and `lerp(DIST, 0, t)` in `applyRow`. ✓
- `SCALE` — `Number` in [0.80, 1.00], set from `scaleSl.value / 100`; used in `lerp(SCALE, 1, t)`. ✓
- `Z` — `Number` in [0.10, 0.40], set from `zoneSl.value / 100`; used in `pos < Z`, `pos > 1 - Z`, `zH = Math.round(h * Z)`. ✓
- `mode` — string `'all' | 'translate' | 'fade'`; read from radio `r.value`; compared via `!==` in `applyRow`. ✓
- `visible` — `Set<HTMLElement>`; populated by `io` callback; iterated with `visible.forEach(applyRow)`. ✓
